output.summary: An evergreen cycad tree found across northeastern India and parts of southern and Southeast Asia into southern China. It has a crown of dark green leaves, unusually large yellowish or orange male cones, and orange to red-yellow seeds when mature.
output.edibilityNote: Young fronds are eaten as vegetables in Manipur and Sikkim; indigenous communities in Assam and nearby Meghalaya eat the starchy seeds raw or roasted.
